text:
Eloise: Quick heads-up — NimbusEdge wants a short perf validation next Mon. Objectives: steady 180 qps with p50 < 65ms and p99 < 320ms, plus microbursts to 1.1k qps for 25s every 12m. They also want a cold-failover check (us-east -> us-west) with degraded performance acceptable but failover < 90s. Need: run plan, infra rec (Dedicated 5xA10G vs hybrid), and a one-page results + commercial delta. Can eng own the run + writeup?

Gabe: I can run it. Clarify model + average token sizes? Cold-starts matter, noted.

Eloise: Model = open-llama-7b-quant, prompt ~140 tok, gen ~70 tok. Include both warm and cold-failover scenarios.

Ritu: Suggested infra: Dedicated 5xA10G in primary (us-east-1) with 2xA10G warm standby in failover region (us-west-2). That gives headroom for bursts without immediate scale-up during failover. For hybrid, recommend 3xcommit + hosted burst capacity.

Gabe: Draft runbook:
- Provision clusters: nimbus-us-east-5gpu, nimbus-us-west-2gpu (warm).
- Warm sequence: prefix-warm for 15m to populate KV and JIT paths.
- Steady run: 180 qps for 2h to capture steady distribution.
- Bursts: spawn 25s jobs to 1100 qps every 12m for 6 cycles.
- Failover: simulate route cut at t+90m, shift traffic to us-west and measure recovery time and p50/p99.
- Capture: p50/p90/p99, gpu_util, queue_len, rejected/timeouts, tokens/sec, and per-1M-token cost estimate.

Load example (internal harness):
./loadrun --url https://api.redwood.dev/v1/generate \
  --payload nimbus_template.json --qps 1100 --duration 25s --concurrency 180

Gabe: Expectations: steady-state should get good batching -> p50 ~55-65ms. Bursts likely to queue; if avg queue_len > 180 during bursts we'll need +1 GPU or enable aggressive batching config. Cold failover without warm standby will exceed 90s due to image pull + model init.

Ritu: Commercial note: rough ballpark before measuring tokens/sec/GPU: Dedicated 5xA10G commit ~ "$95k/mo"; hybrid (3xcommit + burst) tends to add ~15-30% premium during heavy burst windows. I'll refine after the run.

infra-bot:  clusters provisioned: nimbus-us-east-5gpu, nimbus-us-west-warm2gpu. Loadgen nodes up. Model image: open-llama-7b-quant:v1. Warm scripts staged.

Gabe: I'll run a short smoke tonight to validate harness and then schedule full window Mon 01:00-05:00 UTC (low traffic). Eloise, can you confirm customer ok?

Eloise: Confirmed. Also asked legal/security Q: do logs contain user content and what are retention windows? Need short blurb for questionnaire.

security-bot: Pasteable blurb: "We redact user payloads at the edge by default; operational logs retain anonymized request IDs, route and latency metadata only. Retention: metrics 30 days, request traces 7 days. On Private deployments, customers can enable isolated log sinks and customer-managed KMS for full separation."

Ritu: Deliverables: perf dashboard link, 1-page summary (topline numbers + recommendation), and spreadsheet mapping observed tokens/sec per GPU to monthly spend under Dedicated vs Hybrid. Aim to circulate draft Tue EOD.

Gabe: Running smoke now, will post artifacts + dashboard link in this thread after the run.

Eloise: Thanks all. Please keep notes brief in the thread. :rocket:
